message: So, the other day we had a little blackout in the neighborhood, and let me tell you, my candle collection is not as impressive as I thought! It really got me thinking about how unprepared I was for even a short outage. The Red Cross has some great tips on how to get ready for these moments, turning what could be a comedy of errors into a smooth sailing situation. It’s always good to have a plan – because nobody wants to be that person trying to light a fire with two sticks!
